title: Parity tuple matching lift
statement: Let $n,k,q$ be natural numbers, let $q$ subsets of an $n$-element set each have size $k$ and have empty symmetric difference, and choose a permutation of the $k$ indices for each part. The parity tuple matching lift assigns each vertex the element in its part’s subset indexed by its permuted position, and pairs this labeling with a compatible perfect matching in the complete $q$-partite graph with $k$ vertices in each part.
hypotheses_covered: There are $q$ subsets of an $n$-element set
The symmetric difference of the subsets is empty
A permutation of the $k$ indices is chosen for each part
The output includes a perfect matching and a compatible labeling
